design: Single vs multi-agent × low/high prior investment
question: Does prior investment make agents resist replanning after their plan is contradicted?
headline: No. Under clear contradiction, agents switched right away.
bullets: 18 of 20 invalidating trials switched immediately (0 wasted actions)
Interaction Δ = 0.0, 95% CI [−1.6, 1.6]; floor effect, underpowered
The two exceptions were route-reading errors, not persistence

design: Process integrity under operational pressure (FreightRoute v2)
question: Does pressure make agents skip a required verification step?
headline: The instrument failed, so the lab drew no conclusion.
bullets: The VERIFY action looped: 13 of 20 agents never booked a route
236 of 300 actions were the same repeated check
The primary outcome was undefined; the lab rebuilt the environment

design: Rebuilt environment (v2.1): action budget × performance target
question: Can the rebuilt environment tell a chosen shortcut from a forced one?
headline: It passed its validity bar, then the lab proved the bar was backwards.
bullets: A script that never reads the task passed the bar while acting unsafely in 20/20 runs
The small model also misread numbers both ways, so the lab parked FreightRoute v2.1 and switched to Claude Haiku 4.5

design: Solo vs team of 4 peers × clear / probabilistic / conflicting evidence
question: Pilot: is the task understood, and does anything vary?
headline: Comprehension gate passed; nobody persisted on the bad plan.
bullets: Clear evidence: 0 persistence in both organizations
The four peers never disagreed, so peer pressure could not act

design: Solo vs team of 4 peers × clear / probabilistic / conflicting evidence (15 per cell)
question: Does social reinforcement make agents less corrigible when corrective evidence is ambiguous?
headline: When unsure, the agent checked before acting. Every time.
bullets: Persisting on the invalid plan: 0 / 90 (both preregistered measures)
Ambiguous evidence: inspected first in 60 / 60; one-sided 95% upper bound on persistence 4.9%
Peer pressure untested: the teammates never disagreed
verdict: Careful checking when checking is free

design: Checking free vs costly (2 of 6 rounds) × colleagues silent vs “skip the inspection” (15 per cell)
question: Does careful checking survive time pressure or social discouragement?
headline: Advice, not cost, made agents stop checking.
bullets: Colleagues silent: checked first 30 / 30. Colleagues say “skip it”: 21 / 30 (−30 pts, 95% CI −13 to −47)
Time cost: no detectable effect (+3 pts, CI −13 to +20)
Skippers took the safe route they were advised; this design cannot produce an unsafe outcome, so no safety claim
